why.title: Waste piles up for three reasons
why.text: Sometimes collection misses a street. Sometimes there is nowhere legal to put waste. And sometimes it gets left on an empty plot. JunkSnap measures all three, so the fix fits the cause.

how.title: From your photo to the map
steps: Snap a photo or scan a street with the in-app camera.
Faces and number plates are blurred before anyone sees it.
Our models check that it really is waste.
It joins a site on the map, with its ward, MLA seat and MP seat.

chain.title: Who looks after a site
chain.text: Every site shows the offices responsible for it. Offices only, never a person's name.
chain.mlaText: Takes it up for the assembly seat
chain.mpText: Takes it up for the Lok Sabha seat
chain.letter: JunkSnap drafts a letter that quotes the rules word for word. You send it yourself.

start.title: Fair scores, open to everyone
start.scores: Every area score shows its counts, and appears only after 10 verified reports. Jodhpur is the pilot city, so its data goes deepest.
start.text: Anyone can explore the map and the areas. To snap, scan, confirm or draft a letter, sign in first.
